title: Zesty Smoked Russian Haddock Pilaf
description: A hearty post-workout Russian dish featuring smoked haddock, this pilaf is a flavorful and flaky meal, made with a papillote cooking method to lock in the zesty flavors.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the flaked smoked haddock, brown rice, lemon juice, olive oil, dried dill, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Spoon the mixture into a large piece of parchment paper, creating a tight packet with a papillote fold.
Place the packet on a baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the packet from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Carefully open the packet and fluff the pilaf with a fork.
Serve the pilaf hot, garnished with additional dried dill if desired.
Refrigerate or freeze any leftovers for later use.
